/root/autodl-tmp/pacs/paper/introduction.tex:Prior work has characterized compound interaction as a property of the sparsity level---higher sparsity yields more interaction---but treats the interaction magnitude as roughly constant across the generation process \cite{spark-aaai2026, unicomp-2026}.
/root/autodl-tmp/pacs/paper/introduction.tex:This assumption is problematic for reasoning-capable models, whose generations are structurally heterogeneous: a single chain-of-thought trace alternates between phases of broadly distributed attention (exploratory reasoning) and phases of sharply concentrated attention (structured computation) \cite{thinkv-iclr2026, decision-repr-transition-2026}.
/root/autodl-tmp/pacs/paper/related_work.tex:\cite{spark-aaai2026} report super-additive degradation when combining channel pruning with token eviction, with up to 65\% quality loss exceeding individual component effects---the first explicit measurement of this phenomenon in KV cache sparsity.
